definitions.gloss: prisoner of war (POW); captive taken in battle
definitions.explanation: A person captured and held by the enemy during a war or armed conflict.

examples.japanese: {捕虜|ほりょ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{交換|こうかん}→交換：02746_koukan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{行|おこな}われた→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: A prisoner exchange was carried out.

examples.japanese: ⟦{戦争|せんそう}→戦争：01450_sensou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{終|お}わった→終わる：00567_owaru⟧⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧、{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{捕虜|ほりょ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{故郷|こきょう}→故郷：02733_kokyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{帰|かえ}る→帰る：00508_kaeru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: After the war ended, many prisoners of war were able to return to their homeland.

notes:
A formal word used in military and historical contexts. Frequently appears in news reporting, history textbooks, and discussions about international law and the Geneva Conventions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {捕虜|ほりょ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to become a prisoner of war
- {捕虜|ほりょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧: to take prisoners
- {捕虜|ほりょ}⟦{収容所|しゅうようじょ}→収容所：22753_shuuyoujo⟧: POW camp
- {捕虜|ほりょ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{交換|こうかん}→交換：02746_koukan⟧: prisoner exchange
- {捕虜|ほりょ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{解放|かいほう}する→解放する：22170_kaihousuru⟧: to release prisoners of war

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{囚人|しゅうじん}→囚人：20680_shuujin⟧: prisoner — a person imprisoned for a crime, not specifically war-related
- ⟦{人質|ひとじち}→人質：09678_hitojichi⟧: hostage — a person held for ransom or leverage
- {俘虜|ふりょ}: prisoner of war — an older, more literary synonym rarely used today
